items.problem: Many non-fatal nullable-reference warnings (CS8618/CS8600/CS8602/CS8604/CS8625) from porting un-annotated UWP fields/properties into a <Nullable>-enabled scaffold.
items.evidence: build-output.txt: ~25 CS86xx warnings across SampleConfiguration.cs, 4/5-*.xaml.cs, MainPage.xaml.cs; 'BUILD SUCCEEDED'.
items.covered_clearly_at: N/A — these are warnings, not failures. The build succeeded and the app scored 100; nullable hygiene is generic C# behavior the model handles on its own and does not block migration.
items.why_no_skill_change: Warnings did not affect build, run, or score. Adding skill prose to chase non-fatal nullable warnings would bloat the skill with low-leverage noise; a capable re-run produces the same passing build. Not a generalizable migration defect.
